findings.limitations: One frozen method, two fixed-case executions; replication is not novelty or held-out generalization. Equation validity is separate from operating feasibility; six Q violations persist and 186 thermal limits are unassessed. No infeasibility, uniqueness, robustness, speed ranking or causal tolerance-benefit proof. No alternative solver, baseline or ablation tested. Evaluator leaves experimental design, hypothesis assessment and generalization unassessed; interpretations are author claims. Artifact verification is recorded, independence basis is evaluator attestation, and isolation_verified_by_service is false despite reported isolation facts. Deliberately interrupted source process was recovered from completed durable evidence without resubmission. Both numerical outcomes retained; no new test proposed or executed. Initial publication request was rejected as invalid_finding; this corrected request tests string-valued limitations without changing numerical evidence.
findings.statement: Candidate 6ad49cab1e5d5b1379828834c6310b9eb80e8b6701481480bdf58a5759dfe6a6 completed source trial_afbad5dec9e64b8d96fe3ec916bbea68 and fresh frozen-method replica trial_60d58ad443ea4ae1b5818522d6780721 (803/570 ms charged execution). Completed independent Validation IDs validation_evaluation_8ec51898c20d48fbbe26cdad2fb4a169 and validation_evaluation_5f76d36c5f3f4080bff3e23b53cf2307 report preserved inputs and valid original equations, max mismatch 3.9307660706864565e-13 pu in both, but six reactive-generation violations (IDs 8,14,15,42,45,47) and 186 unassessed thermal limits. Comparison Validation validation_replay_evaluation_5f76d36c5f3f4080bff3e23b53cf2307 supersedes the replica Validation and records consistent bytewise replication in distinct containers. Author interpretation supports preregistered p3-689915c3fcd2/fixed-nr-tight revision 1's equation/completion prediction; post-hoc revision 2 retains the operating counterevidence and limits the conclusion to a reproducible equation solution, not operating feasibility. Research note snapshot: bb665f7a92262cb941405f88e84ddb3a84700fddd821bb6dda7b31abb865dbb2.
